description: This file defines the internal class 'PeriodicAction', which manages executing a specified action periodically based on a given time interval.

classes.name: PeriodicAction
classes.description: A class that encapsulates logic to perform an action at regular time intervals.

methods.name: PeriodicAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the periodic action with a specified interval, action delegate, and optional start time.

methods.name: TryAction
methods.description: Attempts to execute the action if the current time has reached or surpassed the scheduled next run time.
